description: From the Swiss landing at Les Brenets, Lac des Brenets is a narrow dark lake between limestone walls, and the gorge fades into night fog. A few small boats sit at the Swiss shore. The far bank is France and is not presented as a Swiss place, and the downstream waterfall stays out of frame. This replaces La Chaux-de-Fonds, already published. The Open-Meteo model is fog, about 7°C, with cloud cover near 94%, very humid air, a light wind, and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
